title: Uniform Chebyshev approximations of functions satisfying a variation-type condition: reconstruction of time-varying signals on graphs
summary: We prove uniform approximation theorems for Chebyshev expansions of continuous functions of two variables. Under a variation-type condition on the square $[-1,1]^2$, a continuous function admits a uniformly convergent Chebyshev expansion in the first variable whose coefficients are continuous functions of the second variable.
